$comment: Per-exam authoring contract, declared at S3 (2026-08-17). Themes Z1-Z7 were proposed in derivation/source-ms-learn-az900-modules.md and are ratified here: the T1-T8 architecture starter set fits this foundational exam poorly (no autonomy-level or trust-boundary judgments exist at 'describe' altitude); theme_definitions carries the one-line judgment each theme exercises. pattern_extensions E01-E05 are the five discrimination-failure mechanisms the three Artefact A documents observed that the shared D01-D20 judgment registry does not name (definitions and evidence counts in derivation/source-ms-learn-az900-modules.md; caps and raise-targets in manifest.validation.pattern_caps + derivation/master-inventory.md). These E-ids are az-900's own registry and are unrelated to any other exam's extensions. Verticals are authored fresh at S3 as organisational settings for cloud-adoption scenarios - none is copied from a source scenario or another exam's list.

theme_definitions.Z1: Concept identification — name the cloud concept, deployment model, service model or benefit behind a described situation
theme_definitions.Z2: Service selection — pick the Azure service or tool that performs the required job, against near neighbours that perform adjacent jobs
theme_definitions.Z3: Scope & topology placement — put the thing at the right level: resource group vs subscription vs management group, datacenter vs zone vs region vs region pair, VNet vs subnet vs peering
theme_definitions.Z4: Cost & commercial judgment — pricing model, cost lever, or the difference between estimating spend and analysing it
theme_definitions.Z5: Resilience judgment — choose the construct that survives the stated failure class: component, rack, datacenter, zone, region
theme_definitions.Z6: Identity & access judgment — authentication vs authorization, sign-in signals, role scope and how assignments combine
theme_definitions.Z7: Governance control placement — the control that meets the obligation: prevent vs protect vs authorise vs classify vs observe
